name: EFS Content
description: Portable curated datasets for Ethereum File System deployments.

datasets.title: Web Games
datasets.licensePosture: CC0-1.0 and MIT; preserve in-file MIT notices
datasets.description: Single-file HTML5 games, playable in a sandboxed iframe.

datasets.title: Crypto Whitepapers
datasets.licensePosture: papers hosted as published by their projects or authors; most carry no licence (owner decision 2026-10-27: no licence field required for documents)
datasets.description: Major cryptocurrency whitepapers and reference notes.

datasets.title: Ethereum Standards
datasets.description: Landmark Ethereum standards (EIPs/ERCs), public domain under CC0.

datasets.title: Cypherpunk Canon
datasets.licensePosture: local PDFs are CC BY-SA or public domain; the two manifestos are hosted in full (owner decision 2026-10-27); other works are CC0 link-only records
datasets.description: A rights-aware shelf representing 21 cypherpunk works with local reading files or link-only records.
